verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents background automation like automatic compliance monitoring, evidence collection, and review reminders (docs-30, docs-35, docs-9/34), and an MCP server letting an AI assistant act within the workspace (docs-1, docs-28). However, there's no evidence of user-configured autonomous AI agents/workflows that run unsupervised on a schedule or trigger — MCP usage is framed as interactive assistant queries rather than persistent background automations. missing for 10: documented scheduling/trigger mechanism for AI-driven automations, evidence of unattended multi-step agent runs, independent confirmation of autonomous operation.
